purpose: Resolve the minimum classification and fact requirements before a rent-review proposition is applied.

steps.condition: tenancy_type in [Student Specific Accommodation, Approved Housing Body, Cost Rental, Local authority housing]

outcomes.FACT_REQUIRED: More facts are needed before the applicable rule can be resolved.
outcomes.ROUTE_TO_SPECIAL_REGIME: The private-tenancy rent proposition set must not be applied automatically.
outcomes.SHOW_EVIDENCE: Return applicable proposition IDs, evidence chain, unresolved facts and official route.

safety_rules: Never infer tenancy classification from rent amount alone.
Never treat a missing exception as proof that no exception exists.
Never convert a historical rule into a current rule without date analysis.
Never produce a definitive individual legal outcome from incomplete facts.
